```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(targets)
library(performance)
library(see)
library(ggplot2)

# This allows you to run chunks interactively outside the pipeline
tar_config_set(store = "_targets")
```

```{r load-checks}
# Load the model checks target created by our pipeline
tar_load(itv_model_checks)
```

## Intraspecific Trait Variation: Diagnostic Plots

Below are the graphical diagnostic checks for each trait's linear mixed model (`value_trans ~ 1 + (1|region/site) + (1|taxon)`). These plots evaluate assumptions such as the normality of residuals, homoscedasticity, and random effect distributions.

```{r plot-checks, results='asis', fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
for (i in 1:nrow(itv_model_checks)) {
  trait <- itv_model_checks$trait_trans[i]
  category <- itv_model_checks$class[i]
  
  # Print markdown heading for the trait
  cat("\n\n### Trait:", as.character(trait), "(", as.character(category), ")\n\n")
  
  # Extract and print the check_model plot object
  plot_obj <- itv_model_checks$model_check[[i]]
  
  # Print the plot so Quarto correctly captures the output during the loop
  print(plot_obj)
}
```
